snippet.title: Aquarist - Japanese Garden DLC Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Aquarist - Japanese Garden DLC. Coming out on the 19th of June. 
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802320/Aquarist__Japanese_Garden_DLC

Get the largest and most beautiful location that comes with a plethora of new fish🐟🐠, decorations🖼️, plants🍀, and other interesting additions. 

#Aquarist #japanesegardendlc #relaxing
